newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.07 down at 41.15 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday amid higher buying of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open stable on Friday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.90 percent compared to the opening at 2.60 percent.
